name: void-miners-extended
title: Void Miners 2 Extended
author: n0t49a1n
description: Void Miners adds a new way to produce resources on a small or large scale, helping you thrive on resource-poor or island maps. Use electricity to produce ores, raw minerals, and naturally sourced fluids. Production is expensive and relatively slow, so mining remains an important part of your factory. Upgrade to faster, more capable machines as you progress. Supports resources from BZ mods, including BZ Aluminium 2 (bzaluminum2), Krastorio 2, Space Exploration, and Space Age. Pyanodon support is a work in progress. Features: Basic, Refined, and Advanced miners for use outside space; Space and Deep miners for use in Space Exploration; Space Age miners and wells; fluid wells; separate resource recipes and compatibility for supported mods; ordered recipes for easier resource selection; and optional hard mode that doubles miner and well power use and crafting ingredients. New in 2.0: removed OmniFluid, Science Ores, Classic Mode, and catalysts; reworked miner names, crafting recipes, and research requirements; added Space Exploration miners, usable only in space; added separate compatibility for BZ mods, Krastorio 2, and Space Exploration; reworked the mod structure and added new entity colors; reintroduced fluid wells.
